optimized.title: Pakistan Just Picked Iran's Side
optimized.fullVoiceover: Pakistan just picked Iran. Six overland routes opened through Balochistan, bypassing the blockaded Strait of Hormuz entirely. Three thousand containers from Karachi rerouted overnight. Pakistan's military is securing the Gwadar-to-Gabd corridor. China and Pakistan now side with Iran. The US stands alone with Israel. India is the only major economy buying from both sides. New Delhi just became the most important phone call in geopolitics. Modi can pressure Tehran. Modi can pressure Washington. So what does Washington do now?
